description: This file defines the URL class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and key-value handling functionalities. It includes URL scheme enumeration, key-value management, and methods for URL validation and text representation.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Represents a URL with parsing, validation, and encoding functionalities, supporting different schemes and URL components.
